texts.facts: Secondly in the above said year she approached the SDM and other concerned authorities by filing an application and affidavit for issuance of SC Certificate and fraudulently claimed herself as daughter of Shri Ramey and on such inducement the concerned SDM had issued SC Certificate while in fact she was not her daughter thereby committed an offence punishable U/s 420 IPC. a false entry shown herself as daughter of Shri Ramey for the purpose of cheating with the concerned authorities thereby committed an offence punishable U/s 468 IPC. Predecessor of this Court framed charges against accused Sunita Bharti on 01.11.2004 U/s 419/420/468/471 to which she pleaded not guilty and claimed trial. During the course of his duties as SDM, Rajouri Garden, accused Sunita claiming herself to be daughter of Shri Ramey son of Shri Attar Singh, R/o C-48, Babu Park, Delhi moved an application dated 05.03.2002 for issuance of SC Certificate. Along-with an application she submitted an affidavit, copy of food card and cast certificate of Shri Ramey which she identified belonged to her father. Alongwith the above-said documents accused had also submitted schedule cast certificate (hereinafter referred to SC Certificate) of her husband Ghanshyam and moved an application form duly attested by Shri Shadi Ram, Member Legislative Assembly, Delhi. On receipt of application form alongwith documents the then Tehsildar marked the application alongwith documents for verification purpose to the concerned bailiff. The bailiff after verification submitted his report to Tehsildar and Tehsildar recommended the report of bailiff and the application alongwith documents were submitted to him. On the basis of the said documents as well as on the VASUNDHARA CHHAUNKAR CHHAUNKAR Date: FIR No.246/2002 State Vs. Sunita Bharti Page No.3 of 272024.12.06 04:37:32 +0530 basis of the recommendation of Shri M.L. Bakolia's report, a schedule cast certificate dated 05.03.2002 was issued in favour of the accused. 31. The accused did not lead any DE.
